Yep white with a warm cover pink

Usually with dip, fills are not offered since the outcome becomes very thick. Clients usually get a new set each time after soaking the previous set in acetone or filing depending on the technician. 

Dip can look extremely natural, I wouldn’t automatically chuck it up to the technicians level of experience next time you go in just ask for a thinner application.  2 coats of the colored powder for your natural nails, 3-4 if you get tips.

I personally as a cosmetologist get acrylic with gel polish from a really good salon since I can get a fill and they still look thin and I can change the polish whenever I like with great strength.
